question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: After working on creator-related products for three years at Pinterest—and talking with dozens of creators about the challenges they faced—Varun and Leon began brainstorming different ways creators could better monetize the enormous value they delivered to their audiences and to brands. After testing a number of concepts, they became excited by the idea of building better discovery experiences to help brands find creators for their campaigns. A mutual friend connected them with Carina, who was independently building something similar. Andrew had also previously worked with Varun and Leon on discovery at Pinterest, and joined the team as well. Soon after, 1stCollab was born!

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: We’re focused on solving a two-sided marketplace problem, for brands and creators. For brands, their biggest pain point with influencer marketing is discovering and sourcing creators. Platforms that exist today not only cost >$30k each year, but have very limited discovery capabilities. For instance, [Grin.co](http://Grin.co), one of the top two influencer marketing platforms today, does not surface any Instagram influencers as part of their sourcing tools. We’re going to be the first influencer marketing platform that prioritizes discovery and create the best discovery experience for brands by growing a network of authenticated creators and surfacing those creators through industry leading discovery algorithms and experiences. For creators, 99% of creators don’t get brand deals today, because creators don’t have a way to actively apply to relevant campaigns. By creating an open platform that has a broad set of brands, we can help creators apply to campaigns by showcasing those brands and their campaigns to relevant creators. Creators know their audience and content the best, and through encouraging creator participation, we can facilitate better matchmaking between brands and creators than any platform out there.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: From working at social media companies, we know that users engage at much higher rates with sponsored creator content than organic ads. But the market for sponsored influencer content is being held back, because it’s hard to run influencer marketing campaigns and the tools out there today don’t make it much easier. 1stCollab will simplify and automate influencer marketing the same way that Facebook and Google transformed the digital ads market. If we’re successful, we’ll enable a new category of ad spend—helping more brands to leverage influencer marketing and shift more of their budgets towards it. That’s money that goes directly to creators, enabling orders of magnitude more people to make a living as full-time creators. We have the opportunity to make content creation a genuinely feasible career for many, many talented folks out there—and we’re excited to make it happen.

launches.title: 1stCollab - Fully-automated, ROI-optimized influencer marketing
launches.tagline: Build a community of thousands of creators for your brand–instantly
launches.body:
**tl;dr**: 1stCollab is the fastest way to test, optimize, and scale your influencer program. Instantly source thousands of creators, and let our platform handle everything — outreach, negotiations, contracting, payments, and taxes — all while maximizing ROI.

**Product Demo:** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0KI3LN-xqdM

**Ask**: Introduce [leon@1stcollab.com](mailto:leon@1stcollab.com) to companies interested in influencer marketing!

## The Problem

We’ve spoken with hundreds of startups running influencer programs, and nearly all hit the same roadblocks:

* **Low response rates.** They reach out to about 10-20 influencers and don’t get any responses. 
* **Time-consuming processes.** Even if some creators reply, sourcing, negotiating, contracting, and paying them quickly turns into a full-time job (or an agency retainer).
* **Scaling is hard.** Early success is exciting, but optimizing and expanding campaigns takes costly tools, headcount, and process.

## What 1stCollab does

1stCollab helps you test out and scale your influencer marketing program to hundreds of creators with an hour of setup work. We do this by automating the exact same influencer process that the world’s best marketing teams run. 

Here’s how it works:

**Step 1: Instantly source thousands of influencers**

Free to try out! We’ve indexed all of TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube so you’ll quickly be able to find relevant creators using our search and recommendation tools.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94796&key=user_uploads/1168808/7c914441-b10e-4367-99c6-253a39f48bf6)

**Step 2: We take care of outreach, negotiations, contracting and payments.** 

We handle everything to bring the right creators on board at the right price. You’ll see the full negotiation history and campaign pipeline. Our pricing engine predicts ROI using real-time engagement signals and proprietary data from hundreds of thousands of deals.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94796&key=user_uploads/1168808/05e49138-75eb-4fdc-b941-e24044207a7d)

**Step 3: (Optional) Review content**

Creators submit concepts and draft videos for your approval. All revisions stay organized in one place. Once you give the green light, we take care of payouts and collect performance data.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94796&key=user_uploads/1168808/fc46b925-16b3-4ef8-82df-1380a85dec64)

\
**Step 4: Analyze your metrics**

As creators are going live, we’ll report out on real time engagement and link click metrics. We’ll cut things by ad groups as well so you can experiment with different briefs and creator populations to understand what works well. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94796&key=user_uploads/1168808/90bbd692-5064-454d-a9c4-a20748bd411e)

## Some of our campaigns

We’ve helped hundreds of startups start their influencer campaigns and scale up to **some of the largest campaigns on social media**. Some interesting case studies to check out include [Framer](https://brands.1stcollab.com/customers/framer), [Locket](https://brands.1stcollab.com/customers/locket), [Gamma](https://brands.1stcollab.com/customers/gamma) and [SnapCalorie](https://brands.1stcollab.com/customers/snapcalorie)!

## How to get started

Start [sourcing creators for free](https://brands.1stcollab.com/) or schedule [some time with Leon](https://calendar.app.google/Zd88eFtzJF3TKs3k6) so we can discuss campaign strategy and we can share with you best practices

Already running influencer campaigns? A/B test us against your current program — we’re confident we can improve your performance and efficiency!

launches.title: 1stCollab — Run an influencer marketing campaign in less than 30 minutes 🎉
launches.tagline: 1stCollab is an AI-powered influencer marketing platform that automates the process of running an influencer marketing campaign.
launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

Influencer marketing is one of the most efficient ways to reach and acquire new customers, but it’s tedious to run campaigns. By leveraging machine learning and our prior campaign data, 1stCollab lets you run a campaign in under 30 minutes. Visit [1stcollab.com](http://1stcollab.com) to get started with your next influencer marketing campaign!

### **Why is influencer marketing hard?**

From our time working at large social media platforms, we know that influencer marketing consistently outperforms organic ads. Unfortunately, launching an influencer campaign is a manual and lengthy process. _Launching an influencer campaign takes weeks_, while launching Google ads takes just minutes. 

The first step of every influencer campaign is to find the right creators to work with—which often takes over 50 hours per campaign. Existing solutions cost tens of thousands of dollars and operate off inaccurate data. As a result, the majority of influencer marketers spend hours manually searching on YouTube, TikTok, or Instagram. From there, they have to manually calculate stats, vet a creator’s audience, evaluate past partnerships, and negotiate rates and contract terms, review creatives, report out campaign metrics, and finally submit payments. This whole process often takes 2+ weeks for a single campaign.

### **How does it work?**

1stCollab lets you launch an influencer marketing campaign in minutes—not weeks. All you have to do is find a single influencer who's relevant to your brand and target customers. Then:

1. Use our [influencer look-alike discovery tool](https://www.1stcollab.com/) to identify, vet, and save additional influencers you'd like to work with. We do what the best influencer marketers do: identify a single relevant creator, dig through that creator’s community, identify additional relevant creators, and repeat the process—but automatically.
2. Send us your list of saved influencers and tell us about your campaign goals and budget.
3. We'll take care of everything from there. All you have to do is approve the content that the influencers will post.

We support campaigns on all platforms. Our self-serve discovery tool currently supports YouTube, and we’re launching for Instagram and TikTok soon.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=70145&key=user_uploads/1168808/a5397e58-9fda-4820-8ec8-945d2930f80d)

### **Our Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=70145&key=user_uploads/1168808/214846e7-6c27-47c6-9213-4ecac24313be)

Our team has built some of the largest and most-used discovery and ML systems in the world, and has led industry-leading influencer marketing programs.

* [Leon](https://www.linkedin.com/in/leonqlin/) spent nine years at Pinterest, where he was most recently Head of Discovery Product. 
* [Varun](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bansalvarunb/) was at Pinterest for five years, where he led product for both the Creator Engagement and Recommendations teams. 
* [Carina](https://www.linkedin.com/in/carina-cater/) led influencer marketing at Whatnot, Robinhood, and Curology.
* [Andrew](https://www.linkedin.com/in/zeyu-liu/) was the tech lead for the Recommendations and Search team at Coupang and the Recommendations team at Pinterest.
* [Kevin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kevinlau93/) was a Founding Engineer and tech lead for the Machine Learning team at Abnormal Security and earlier, an engineer on the Recommendations team at Pinterest.

### **Our Ask**

* **Want to give influencer marketing a try?** We'd love to help! We're the easiest and fastest way to do it. Our discovery tool is free to try and we’re happy to help you run the rest of your campaign.
* **Know someone doing influencer marketing?** We'd love to be connected. Even if our product isn't the right fit, we’d love to know how we can make their process faster and improve their performance.
* **No plans to run an influencer marketing campaign?** Feel free to use our discovery tool and explore creators you might want to work with in the future! We'd love to get feedback on the discovery experience.

If you have any questions, shoot us an email at [hello@1stcollab.com](mailto:hello@1stcollab.com)!

launches.title: Kite: Apple-style product videos in minutes
launches.tagline: Kite helps software companies create stunning marketing videos in minutes.
launches.body:
### 🏎️ TLDR

Kite helps software companies create stunning marketing videos in minutes. Take a screen recording of your product and turn it into a polished video–no experience required.\
\
👉 Try out Kite on Mac OS (alpha): [**https://kite.video**](https://kite.video?ref=launchyc)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74042&key=user_uploads/282294/6bca3709-f628-4c2b-a533-6fb825209d17)

👋 Hey there!

Derek and Todd from Kite here.

### 🥲 The Problem

Top companies know that the way they present themselves to the world matters. **Great storytelling amplifies great products**.

When Apple launches a product—or even the tiniest feature—they don’t just put out a press release or a Tweet. They put on something closer to a cinematic film premiere—using video to craft a story and make their audience truly appreciate their features, one by one.

Most of us aren’t Apple, but need to tell our story all the same. **Nearly every software company needs marketing videos**, not just once, but continuously.

Users prefer video to text and social algorithms boost it heavily.

The world is noisy. Every feature release is an opportunity to relaunch your product and tell your company’s story once again.

(Some companies we think crush it with frequent feature launch videos: Framer, Brex, and Vercel).

**The thing is, making great marketing videos is still _really_ hard.**

Derek has been pulling out his hair making startup marketing videos for over a decade, both for his own products and as a contractor.

Existing solutions are either **bland**, **tedious**, or **expensive**:

* **Simple screen captures** work well for internal communication but aren’t great for grabbing attention externally, and tend to all look the same. Attention spans are short, and a lot of software just…isn’t that engaging on its own.
* You can cobble together **powerful video tools** (After Effects, etc), but you’ll probably spend way longer than you’d like, end up with a janky result, and feel like you should have earned a film degree by the end.
* Or, you can **hire a video creator** (contractor, agency, or full-time). Tech companies spend a LOT on marketing video creation (We know, we’ve talked to your video people!).

### 🪁 The Solution

Our goal with Kite is to help any software company create studio-quality marketing videos—no studio required.

Here’s a quick Kite video we made for our Product Hunt launch this week:

[ ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u2Gz6JI2KSk)

We start with **screen capturing** your product. It’s easy. If you can take a Loom, you can take a Kite.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74042&key=user_uploads/282294/e83335c6-d414-483e-a806-fd7726d03239)

Then we turn it into a ridiculously professional video—semi-automatically.

* Show off your app on the screen of a **3D device model** (like a laptop).
* Kite **automatically moves the camera** to follow the action and highlight the features your cursor is interacting with.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74042&key=user_uploads/282294/c491535d-1987-4417-a0aa-fca72a90b324)

* Add **animated text** (kinetic typography) with two clicks.
* Sync it all together to the beat of a music track from our **music library**
* Check out our tutorial video for more detail:

[ ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o1lhSIGDW98)

(**This entire video was made in Kite**, you can explore the full project file in the app).

### 🛣️ Roadmap

We want to make Kite more comprehensive and automatic with each update–abstracting away all the tedious parts of making great videos, and giving you all the cool stuff you see in big co-marketing videos for free, so can let your creativity run wild.

We've only been working on Kite for a few months, but there's a lot coming!

* **AI-assisted video creation**
  * **LLMs** – Chat with Kite like you’d chat with a video creator. Get help with everything from copy editing and storytelling to animations and fonts.
  * **Generative AI** – narrations, music, graphics, 3D objects
  * 3D object scans for physical product demos
* More **customization**–animations, text effects, music, 3D devices, backgrounds, cursors, etc
* **Mobile videos** & iPhone screen capture
* Designer **templates**

### 🔮 The future

* We’re starting with software videos because it’s an area we know well, but we’re not stopping there. We think the web is a more engaging place where everyone can create great videos and we're excited to help create the next generation of **AI-first video tools**.

### 👉 Try out Kite on Mac OS (alpha): [**https://kite.video**](https://kite.video?ref=launchyc)

You can use the entire product **for free**, just upgrade to remove watermarks.

Send us feedback, bug reports, and questions! [support@kite.video](mailto:support@kite.video)\
\
Derek & Todd (& Harvey 🐶)\
Kite\
🪁🪁🪁

launches.tagline: Bringing main-street business acquisitions to the 21st century
launches.body:
# Overview

Hi everyone, we’re [Kunal](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kunal-puri1/) and [Michael](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mning1598/) from [Smobi](https://smobimarket.com/)!

Smobi is a marketplace that makes it **easy for buyers** to purchase brick & mortar small businesses. We do this by **verifying business listing data** and **managing deal-flow** on our platform.

Website: [smobimarket.com](http://smobimarket.com)

![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fc69c6f56-e67a-45b9-904d-ee8c7ea7f4f0_3456x1812.png)

### **The Problem:**

* Buyers have to go through numerous listings to find quality businesses because most listings are **incomplete and misrepresented**
* Business brokers and owners who are looking to sell, **waste their time** working with buyers who aren’t qualified to purchase their business
* In the past 30 years, technology has only changed the business for sale market in **two** ways:
  * Listings have moved online instead of being in the local newspaper
  * Financial documents are emailed instead of being sent via mail
* The baby boomer generation is retiring over the next decade, who owns **1\.4 million businesses** that will close their doors unless they are sold to someone willing to buy them

### **The Solution:**

For those looking to buy, we utilize first and third party data to screen listings, so buyers are looking at the complete picture of the business that is for sale. Buyers can keep track of the state of each of the listings they are interested in and manage deal flow on the platform.

![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F4c68aba5-bbb6-4d50-9daf-4afef20fb191_3456x1822.png)

Additionally, we create NDA protected data rooms with more in-depth documents for each listing on our website. If the broker / seller of the business thinks you’re a good match for buying the business, we send the data room to the buyer.

For those looking to sell their business, we create a comprehensive profile for each buyer that is interested in a listing that the seller has created. Using data that the buyer has provided and our internal business logic, we classify how well of a match a person is for your business, ultimately saving time in your search for a buyer.

![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F465d0d7a-7313-4cb9-a80a-e6011294ea8c_3454x1828.png)

### **Our Vision:**

Our long term vision is to **digitize the entire acquisition process** for main-street businesses, ultimately making small business ownership attainable for everyone.

### **Who Are We?**

Hi everyone, we are Kunal and Michael, and we are building Smobi. Our mission is to make small business ownership attainable by everyone.

Kunal formerly worked in Amazon Advertising, where he built several notification delivery channels that supported 10B+ communications annually. Kunal spent over 6 months in 2022 looking to purchase multiple SMBs and found the process of finding and purchasing a business to be extremely complex, especially for a first time buyer.

Before Smobi, Michael worked at another YC startup, Dover, as an early engineer where he worked on growth initiatives and building AI products.

Kunal and Michael grew up together, have known each other for 10 years, and now both reside in NYC. Together, we are attempting to simplify the small business acquisition process for all parties involved.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73135&key=user_uploads/846621/2ed626b9-972e-4a72-84c0-fe19ecf48dee)

### **Our Asks**

Thank you for reading about Smobi! We welcome any feedback for our platform as we are just beginning!

* **Sign up today**: Sign up and browse 700+ businesses for sale and get notified when businesses come up for sale tailored to your preferences.
* **Join our newsletter**: Sign up for our [blog](https://smobi.com/blog) for guides on how to buy and sell SMBs!
* **Give us your feedback**: Tell us more about what criteria and information you would want before purchasing a SMB
* **Connect us**: Help us connect with SBA approved lenders, business brokers, people looking to purchase small businesses, and owners looking to sell their business

> **TL;DR:**

[_Resonance_](https://www.useresonance.com/) _is an ad server for house ads (self-promotional marketing). Companies use Resonance as a one-stop shop for campaign creation, intelligent experimentation/prioritization, analytics, and impression management to boost net revenue retention following user onboarding._ [_Schedule a demo_](https://calendly.com/jonathantou/quick-chat) or [_get in contact_](https://www.useresonance.com/contact).

> **The Team:**

I used to work as a SWE at Dropbox, DoorDash, and Microsoft. In particular, I helped build a similar platform to Resonance at Dropbox that generated $100 million ARR. I wanted to start Resonance because 1) I felt there were many ways to improve that particular tool and 2) I wanted to bring that tool to other companies that need it but don’t have the bandwidth to build it themselves.

> **The Problem:**

For companies that depend on product-led growth (primarily consumer/SMB/startup-centric companies), their website remains their most valuable marketing channel. Post-user onboarding, these companies rely on in-product messaging to drive feature adoption so they can retain users.

Unfortunately, this sort of strategy only works at scale, and there are many challenges in doing so. Below are some non-trivial functionalities that modern companies require to launch effective campaigns with velocity:

1. Code-based and no-code workflows for launching campaigns
2. Campaign performance analytics
3. Intelligent campaign targeting and experimentation
4. Sophisticated campaign impression management
5. UX flexibility (i.e. messaging should not be limited just to overlays)

Solving this problem is crucial, as millions in ARR is left on the table if companies cannot properly scale their in-product feature discovery/awareness/education. Companies like Dropbox that have built tooling to address the above challenges have generated up to $100 million ARR from the increased user retention.

> **The Solution:**

Solving this problem requires building a centralized system where any stakeholder (technical or non-technical) can effortlessly launch campaigns to drive in-product feature adoption.

Holistic assessment of campaign performance, global impression management, and optimized campaign targeting can only work at scale if there is a single system that serves as a repository for all campaigns and governs campaign creation.

Resonance addresses this by providing a central platform where developers and non-developers can both easily launch in-product feature adoption campaigns within minutes, with the above functionalities provided out of the box.

* No code builder with live preview on your website and experimentation

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: When we were heading Growth at Twitter, we saw the power of copy changes. **When we tweaked a push notification from “Elon tweeted” to “Elon _just_ tweeted”, we gained 800K additional users.** We never underestimated the power of copy since that day. The company funded it as a big investment in the difficult years when Twitter’s growth was tanking. However, each change would take 3-6 months to pick, test, approve, and ship. We also didn’t know how to use those learnings systematically to prioritize the next copy change. We started building internal tools to automate this and gained 20% additional user growth. We stumbled upon similar problems and “vision docs” at Pinterest. We knew we were staring at money on the table. We quit our jobs to build [just words](https://justwords.ai).

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
Today, lifecycle marketing is built on manual effort — copywriters brainstorming variants, data scientists running A/B tests, and marketers trying to make sense of disconnected dashboards. Every campaign is a one-off experiment.

In the world we’re building, **AI-marketers** will handle this entire loop — strategy, creation, optimization, and learning — with humans acting as orchestrators, not operators.

* Campaigns will **self-evolve**: AI agents will detect new opportunities, write and test messages, measure outcomes, and continuously improve.
* Brands will move from **batch campaigns** to **living systems** — always-on, hyper-personalized, cross-channel journeys that adapt in real time.
* Every marketer, no matter their company size, will have access to enterprise-level intelligence — a strategist, a creative, an optimizer, and a data scientist — all in one AI team.

The world will shift from “humans using tools” to **humans teaming with AI agents**.\
And in doing so, we’ll make personalization not just scalable, but truly human again — every message relevant, every experience intelligent, every brand empathetic at scale.

TLDR: Apten is an **omni-channel AI agent** that engages and nurtures leads across **text, call, and email, and webchat.**

Webchat specifically has been around for ages - but when a lead starts a conversation on the website and leaves halfway through, **they’re** **gone.**

Apten is not only able to start a conversation through webchat, but **proactively reach out via SMS/voice/email once the lead goes inactive.**

Today, Apten automates sales/marketing for hundreds of thousands of leads each month - we work with some of the largest enterprises in consumer services (industries including home services, healthcare, education, financial services, and insurance).

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=63At2HXNX4k

# **The Problem**

B2C services companies today **(insurance, home services, financial services, education, etc)** rely on a combination of call centers, dialers, email/sms marketing automation systems to convert new leads.

These systems fall short because:

* Human teams are required to scale up dialing/call efforts (leads slip through the cracks)
* SMS/email automations are typically one-way, static sequences without personalization

# **Our Solution**

Apten automates sales and marketing for B2C enterprises with:

* **Omni-channel capabilities**: set up a single conversational flow that works across SMS, voice, email, and webchat.
  * Apten maintains unified memory across SMS, voice, emai, and webchat (just like a human does) to **personalize conversations at scale**
  * Apten can also **switch between channels** at anytime to **meet a lead where they want to be met**
  * Move leads through different conversational flows depending on **where they are in the customer/lead journey**
* **Intelligent follow-up:** Apten will not only personalize follow-ups based on what it knows about a lead or a past conversation, but it will also dynamically adjust **when to follow-up based on a lead’s repsonse**
  * Personalized AI voicemails can be left on dial attempts that go to an answering machine
  * Apten is able to use local presence dialing to auto-match the number it dials from to one that best matches the lead’s area code
* **AI tools:** Apten can take actions with your systems (scheduling, dialers, quote APIs, etc)
* **Human in the loop:** Handles transfers to your human team at any time (cold or warm). Apten can also dynamically transfer to specific numbers depending on
* **Reliability:** setup custom guardrails that automatically detect non-compliant messages and proactively fix them before they’re sent to the lead

# **Our Ask**

If you’re an enterprise that:

* Falls in a consumer services industry (home services, financial services, insurance, education, healthcare, auto, law, etc)
* Generates a high volume of leads (5k+ leads / mo)
* Uses marketing automation (drip texts/emails, dialer sequences) + a sales team/call center to engage leads over the phone

We’d love to chat - you can find us at http://apten.ai.

launches.tagline: Get fast (7 hours → 10 minutes🔻) & efficient (70% → 93%🔺)
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83213&key=user_uploads/1564365/8f68d0d9-5e48-46ee-852f-a6a841232f11)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83213&key=user_uploads/1564365/d1d98093-7792-4954-bd9d-a588f0658a53)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83213&key=user_uploads/1564365/85f4ffe2-bf2f-4cb2-966c-2501c2b4fbe2)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83213&key=user_uploads/1564365/9cf399d9-e818-4bfb-9da4-42ac9ed3736f)

# **☕️ TL;DR**

* **Ape** is the ultimate **AI prompt engineer** 🐒, designed to optimize your prompts by reducing cost and latency while increasing performance.
* Ape achieves an **impressive 94.5%** on the GSM8K benchmark, surpassing Vanilla (54.5%), CoT (87.5%) and DSPy (90.0%).
* **Easy to set up evaluation**: Ape can auto-generate evaluation code and use LLMs as a judge, or you can use your own eval metrics.
* Get set up in less than 15 minutes and see the difference.
  * [Schedule a meeting](https://cal.com/team/weavel/weavel-onboarding) to discover more. Let's chat! 🙂

# **🔒 Problem**

You’re an engineer of an LLM app, trying to get the prompts just right. Every time you type something in, the output changes—so you tweak a word here and there, and it changes again. Sometimes the outputs looks better, sometimes not. But you’re never sure. Hours go by, all spent on prompt engineering.

Getting the outputs you want can feel like an endless game of trial and error. And you’re not alone. Over the past few weeks, we’ve talked to over 100 YC companies, and a lot of them are facing the same challenges:

* **Measuring output quality is hard** (You’re heavily relying on manual evaluations at the moment.)
* **Prompt engineering does not work as you want** (You hate spending 5-7 hours a day searching for that one great prompt.)

# **🔑 Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83213&key=user_uploads/1564365/ddf5778d-78d0-4ff2-a4aa-b84624aeebc0)

We solve the problem with one simple formula:

```
good input + right guidance = better prompts
```

Today, we launch Ape, your first **AI Prompt Engineer**. Inspired by DSPy, Reflexion, Expel and other research papers, Ape iteratively improves your prompts. Here’s how Ape works:

1️⃣ Log your inputs and outputs to Weavel (with a single line of code!)

2️⃣ Let Ape filter the logs into datasets.

3️⃣ Ape then generates evaluation code and uses LLMs as judges for complex tasks.

4️⃣ As more production data is added, Ape continues refining and improving prompt performance.

### **How to use**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83213&key=user_uploads/1564365/0c1eeedd-ac08-40e7-ad35-acff6766c2c1)

**Create a Dataset**

Change just one line of code to start logging LLM calls with the Weavel Python SDK. The SDK supports sync/async OpenAI chat completions and OpenAI structured outputs.

You can also import existing data or manually create a dataset.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83213&key=user_uploads/1564365/bdfc79bd-edeb-4dbf-8c9b-7d432007fa3a)

**Create a Prompt**

Write a prompt that corresponds to your dataset. You can add an existing prompt as the base version, or if you prefer, create a blank prompt and provide a brief description for Ape to create a prompt from scratch.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83213&key=user_uploads/1564365/1bfacea3-c2d9-4ac8-90d7-9a6d3e37fd60)

**Optimize Prompts**

To optimize your prompt using Ape, fill in the necessary information (e.g. JSON schema as you want) and then run the optimization process. An enhanced version of your prompt will be created and available soon.

Ta-da! It’s that easy. Ape outperforms with a remarkable 94.5% score on the GSM8K benchmark, surpassing Vanilla (54.5%), CoT (87.5%) and DSPy (90.0%). With Ape, you can optimize the prompt engineering process, saving tons of time and cost while increasing performance.

**TLDR;** Financial affiliate programs struggle to ensure affiliates are compliant with brand guidelines, leading to limited growth opportunities. [Affil](https://affil.ai/) monitors affiliate content, enabling companies to expand marketing efforts and maximize revenue.

_What is financial affiliate marketing?_ When you see content by The Points Guy or Forbes that talks about credit cards, checking accounts, etc, they get a kickback from the financial brand for anyone who successfully applies for the product.

### ⚠️ The Problem

Financial institutions (e.g., Capital One) or consumer fintech companies (e.g., Acorns) want to grow their affiliate programs but are completely blocked by compliance barriers. However, it’s expensive and time-intensive to do manual affiliate compliance & management.

On the flip side, affiliates are also dissatisfied with these financial affiliate programs. The majority have to work with disorganized & outdated middlemen hired by financial brands who take a significant cut of payouts.

### 🛠️ The Solution

Our AI compliance software monitors affiliate content so that financial companies know exactly what’s being said about them so that they can expand their marketing efforts:

* Track thousands of affiliate pages 
* Quickly identify compliance violations without needing human intervention
* Create support tickets for every issue, so affiliates & brands can keep track of errors

We’re also improving the affiliate experience:

* Offer higher payouts for conversions (since we have a lower cost structure)
* Provide a beautiful user experience & working APIs
* Proactively identify compliance risks & offer automated suggestions to minimize risk

For example (see below), the AMEX Gold Card underwent significant changes on July 27, 2024, but outdated affiliate content still exists on the internet (that’s not good). We caught this issue that both AMEX and Bankrate missed.

launches.body:
### The Problem:

**GTM search is broken.**

**LLMs over commoditized GTM Databases won’t fix it.**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W9OZ5_KJN5A

**"B2B SaaS, 501-1000 employees, uses Salesforce"** is just targeted spam.

No insights. No buying signals. No understanding of pain. Plus, data for growing markets aren't even present in these databases.

One-time snapshots. No timing. No triggers when pain surfaces. Your competitors have the same database. Everyone's spamming the same channels.

You need 24×7 searches capturing insights as they happen - not after they're stale.

Traditional Intent data is a blackbox and unreliable.

Only Inbound dependence is a reactive approach and prospects are already evaluating competitors by that time.

OpenFunnel automates finding unique, timely insights that get you "ins."

We unlock net new pipeline across GTM functions in Marketing, RevOps, SDRs, and BDRs that were unreachable before.

### **ENTER OPENFUNNEL:**

OpenFunnel is your search engine for inferred pain: you describe the activities that reveal potential pain-points, we find the companies with those pain points, identify the right people, and produce outreach-ready messaging.

**Find companies WHERE Activity happening = \[abc\] AND TimeRange = \[m..n months\]**

Some examples that you can search for:

* Companies implementing usage-based billing in the past 3-6 months - then monitor daily for new ones
* Companies moving from OpenAI to self-hosted Llama in the last 2 months - then track all ongoing migrations
* Companies that are looking to build out their government facing sales motions - then surface all such build outs.
* B2C fintechs attending RSAC Conference in Las Vegas

Live search agents continuously monitor time-based activities and changes across your ICP that matter to your GTM.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94200&key=user_uploads/858828/07397e96-6b5e-4d21-a265-2961783af3bf)

### **LIFE OF CUSTOMERS after Openfunnel:**

GTM teams setup custom insights they want to search and monitor for, in natural language.

OpenFunnel auto-surfaces new and existing accounts with deep actionable insights and sync to CRM, autonomously.

We work with the fastest-moving companies who understand the value of acting quick on insights - including Central, Mintlify, Everest Systems, Fini, and Numi.

Our self-serve platform has 1000+ users.

### **Why We're Building ThiS:**

During F24 batch, we built GTM tools for developer-focused companies with zero knowledge of the GTM toolkit and stack.

Customers loved our first-principles approach - we built what we'd actually want: relevant outreach with real context at the right time.

Then we discovered existing that GTM tools are built on flawed, pre-LLM assumptions and this generalizes across industries.

GTM is timing, insights, and reasoning - exactly what LLMs excel at. As software shifts to agent-first, it becomes a search and discovery problem.

Traditional indexing lacks the temporal + contextual depth for GTM.

So, we're building a time-aware search engine for GTM.

### **🦄 COME Say hi:**

Aditya & Fenil were dorm mates at BITS Pilani & friends for 8 years.

Aditya built AI Agents at scale at Appfolio and Fenil built cloud-scale vector databases at Oracle.

We've talked to 200+ GTM teams across sizes, industries, and AI adoption levels.

We’ve embedded these insights deep into OpenFunnel.

We are in SF at 128 Kings St. next to Oracle Park. Need help with anything GTM? Come say hi.

Join a 1000+ users already using pain-first search to discover their prospects!

Get started for free at - [app.openfunnel.dev](http://app.openfunnel.dev) !

Hey everyone, we’re Andrew and Alan — co-founders of [AthenaHQ.](https://www.athenahq.ai)

# **TL;DR**

[AthenaHQ](https://www.athenahq.ai) helps companies see how their brand appears on generative engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and more. Make sure your company doesn’t get left behind in the paradigm shift from traditional to generative search.

# **The Problem**

In the past, majority of website visits came from traditional Google Search. Now, sites are increasingly getting it from generative engines like ChatGPT. 

From our conversations, we found anecdotally that site traffic attributed to generative engines is increasing month-over-month, picking up in the past few months since the launch of ChatGPT Search in October 2024. **Traditional search engine volume is predicted to drop 25% by 2026, and 50% by 2028**, replaced by traffic originating from generative engines like ChatGPT.

<https://youtu.be/7VobRo3EEok>

# 

#

launches.title: Beluga - Creator Marketing on Autopilot
launches.tagline: Run creator marketing like paid ads
launches.body:
**TL;DR**: We run creator marketing end-to-end so companies can test and scale the channel without needing to hire.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=107925&key=user_uploads/2204818/717d980b-6271-4c94-a779-1c60e4277af9)

Marketers do not need to be convinced that distribution matters.

The harder question is whether a channel can become repeatable before it consumes the whole team.

Creator marketing is one of those channels. It oftentimes performs 3-5x better than traditional digital ads. When it works, it can drive real awareness, clicks, and signups from audiences that are hard to reach through paid ads. But running it well still tends to mean spreadsheets, inboxes, rate negotiations, contracts, draft reviews, tracking links, payment follow-up, and a lot of manual judgment.

That is what we built Beluga to fix.

---

## Why this problem got under our skin

One of the largest spenders in creator marketing made the labor problem concrete for us. They are spending in the high six figures each month, and told us they employ 30+ people to run their creator partnerships. Even then, each rep can only manage around 18 creators.

They also told us that if they had $2M ready to put into the channel tomorrow, they wouldn’t be able to do it. They would need to hire even more people.

That is a wild ceiling for a marketing channel that should scale with spend.

We got pulled into this from both sides.

Fernando saw the brand side up close at Dare Drop, helping gaming publishers run creator campaigns. The demand was real, but the operating model still looked like a traditional agency: lots of coordination, lots of manual work, and a hard ceiling on how much the team could scale.

We also spent time on the creator side while trying to build a Rippling for the self-employed. Working with creators on taxes showed us the other half of the problem: even when a brand deal is a good fit, the process around it is painful. Creators have to find deals that match their audience and content style, align expectations with the brand, actually run the campaign, and then hope they get paid on time.

We kept seeing the same thing from both sides: brands wanted creator marketing to work, creators wanted better deals and less chaos, and everyone was somehow stuck in spreadsheets, email threads, and manual follow-up.

---

## What Beluga does

The problem is not that creator marketing is mysterious. It works when you find the right creators, give them enough room to make authentic content, track the results properly, and run enough shots on goal.

The hard part is doing all of that consistently without making it a headcount problem.

Beluga is our attempt to make creator marketing feel more like running a paid acquisition channel: set the target, set the budget, see what is happening, and double down on what works.

We run campaigns ed-to-end, including:

* Creator sourcing and vetting
* Pricing and negotiation
* Contracting
* Deliverable management
* Creator payments
* Performance tracking
* Post-campaign analysis

The goal is that a founder or growth team can test creator marketing without building the internal machine. If the results are there, we help them scale the channel without turning it into a hiring plan.

Since starting in March, we have generated over 3M views for clients ranging from YC companies to Series F hyperscalers, and saved over $100k in negotiations.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=107925&key=user_uploads/2204818/2dd9d0b8-f197-41aa-aa36-621c473b6569)

_Beluga helped take Freebuff, Codebuff's free coding agent, from roughly 50 to 1,200 daily active users at peak._

For another Series F company, we drove 3,500+ signups in two weeks.

---

## Who Beluga is for

We are most useful when you already believe creator marketing could fit your market, but you do not want the channel to require a whole internal team before it can scale.

Our bet is that the traditional operating model is the problem: most of the sourcing, negotiation, coordination, payments, and reporting should not require dedicated headcount inside every company.

That also changes what is possible. When the work gets cheaper and easier to coordinate, you can test more creators, go after smaller but better-matched channels, and deploy more capital without being bottlenecked by how many deals an internal team can manually manage.

The signal we look for is simple: can we name a real content audience where your users spend time?

"Developers who watch AI coding tool reviews on YouTube" is a clean audience shape. So is a consumer category with obvious creator communities. A niche B2B buyer can still work, but if the buyer is hard to describe in creator and audience terms, or the product only moves through a long enterprise committee, the test usually has less conversion signal.

The other important thing is seriousness about the experiment. Creator marketing is not one magic post. It takes enough well-matched attempts to learn which creators, formats, and messages work. If distribution is a real priority and you want to test the channel properly, that is the conversation we are best suited for.

---

## Why us

The reason we think we can make this work is that we have lived the messy parts.

Fernando ran millions in ad spend at Meta and then sold creator campaigns at Dare Drop. Zan, our Head of Account Management, led outreach across tens of thousands of creators and is a content creator himself. [@Jack Swisher](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2210281) spent years building AI systems at Bubble and now works on building the infrastructure needed to make our vision a reality.

Between us, we have seen the agency side, the creator side, the paid acquisition side, and the automation side.

Our mission is simple: make creator marketing as measurable and easy to run as paid ads.

---

## The ask

If creator marketing is on your roadmap and you do not want the channel to become an internal ops burden, we would love to chat.

And if you know another founder or growth lead who already believes distribution matters and is thinking about creator marketing this year, an intro would be hugely helpful.

[Learn more here](https://www.trybeluga.ai/)

Motives is a team of AI agents that runs qualitative research for consumer brands. Running a focus group can cost $20k+ and take 1-2 months to recruit participants, interview them, and analyze the results - Motives AI runs that whole process in 1-2 days.

**The problem**

Marketing teams thrive on understanding their customers, with large brands spending $100mn/year on consumer research. Today they choose between surveys, which are fast and affordable but shallow, and focus groups or in-depth interviews, which can cost tens of thousands of dollars and take weeks or months.

**The solution**

We’ve built AI agents that can plan, run, and analyze consumer interviews, giving marketing teams deep qualitative insights in days instead of months.

https://youtu.be/dHFtzfFaRKg

Ask a research question, and get results in hours - here’s how it works:

* Customers chat with our AI agent to describe their research questions or the concepts they need to test, and our AI builds a research plan. 
* Our AI then recruits relevant people from our global panel network and interviews them over video.
* The AI automatically analyzes the interviews and generates a report with actionable insights.

launches.tagline: Full stack analytics platform that shows you what users are searching and helps you rank higher on ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Grok.
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We are [Varunram](https://www.linkedin.com/in/varunramg/) and [Sai](https://www.linkedin.com/in/saisamrit-surbehera/), and we’re building Lapis.

The way we access information is fundamentally changing and ChatGPT is the new default for a large number of people. Unlike Google which shows you a list of blue links to click on, ChatGPT adds additional context and traditional SEO elements like rank and authority are no longer relevant.

Here’s a fun video that encapsulates this perfectly: https://youtube.com/shorts/A1zkkdpXsjM?si=TIR2PpnO9Du4DV2O

# What is Lapis?

Lapis helps you rank on AI Search Engines (we currently support ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Grok) without generating hundreds of blogs.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94694&key=user_uploads/482153/d7152bae-e95b-49de-b222-45d4b18a7359)

We manage to do this by extensively analyzing Model responses and a combination of real-time content fixes, technical SEO, and linking websites on domains that are mentioned in models.

# Analyzing AI Search Models

We spend over 650M tokens a day understanding responses for our customers. We construct a super detailed graph of all websites that show up for a given question, analyze the referenced content, and organically insert content on similar pages. This gives us accurate knowledge on what works and what doesn’t work. We want to learn from the models themselves, not create a rough set of heuristics on what might work.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94694&key=user_uploads/482153/fd2bcb1a-26e6-4e76-bf93-34b66739c122)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94694&key=user_uploads/482153/cd700a82-7da5-4eb8-9002-fd9152235052)

# Changing Website Content Dynamically

We dynamically change your website content in real time for AI Search Engines. If Lapis is deployed on a company that does payroll software and a user asks a model “What is the best payroll software”, we highlight them as being the best payroll software and if a user asks “Can you create a comparison table with the top 10 payroll softwares”, we can highlight exactly where the company shines wrt other payroll providers. This removes the guesswork from landing pages for sales and marketing teams, and users and AI Agents get the information they are looking for.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94694&key=user_uploads/482153/d950c296-eaf8-4146-bc19-2d5ef8b2b621)

# Removing the black box from Technical SEO

We fully take care of Technical SEO. For long, SEO has been this black box which no one understands. We solve that through Lapis Agent, which can automatically add meta tags, title tags, Opengraph URLs, sitemaps, and much more. For marketers, this means they don’t have to write code or trouble the engineering team. This also means they don’t have to spend hours with SEO teams on something that can be easily automated.

# Discovering Hidden Markets

Many times, teams don’t know that there’s a huge untapped market waiting for them. With our extensive analysis of prompts, we show all the queries for which businesses are actually showing up for, which means teams get insights into verticals where there’s huge untapped potential.

We want businesses to understand AI Search without the buzzwords. We want them to organically position themselves for this new shift, and to do so without generating spam content that actively harms website reputation.

We support over a hundred fast growing startups like Warp, Reducto, and Greptile on Lapis, and if you’re a founder or marketer, I think you’ll find a ton of value in using us.

And its free to start, so check it out at trylapis.com!

Hey YC!

We're Alisa and Stephen.

Super excited to introduce Bluma - the all in one platform for AI UGC that clones winning organic and paid ad video/slideshows.

It allows you to remix content with a built in video editor and node-based canvas workflows.

We are the first to crack de-editing - cutting each scene, removing and then adding back on caption, text and on screen image popups.

No need to switch between different models and creative platforms to compile clips/assets.

**Problem**

UGC is very time consuming and requires recruitment, week long back and forths and expensive retainers/per video fees.

Oftentimes for both organic and paid, the best way to find a format is to copy adjacent competitors and remake their script/visuals exactly.

The whole process end to end is extremely long and expensive, ranging from researching, briefing, sourcing, reviewing, editing, making variations and distributing.

**Solution**

We believe that AI footage is getting and will continue to get so good that both will converge and be indistinguishable. As such, we can help bring together the whole marketing stack into one platform where all you need is a really good prompter and taste.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98704&key=user_uploads/2724981/abcdeafe-fa89-4ddc-a571-70e9c7b880e5)

Then you can save all your workflows as templates in our node based canvas.

It has never been quicker to build. Most companies are putting out new features or bug fixes daily. But do your users actually know what you shipped today?

\
Building has never been faster, but telling people about it hasn't kept up. Marketing what you shipped is slower than shipping it: record the demo, fumble fifteen takes, design the post, edit the video, get it on-brand, publish. An afternoon gone for twenty seconds of footage. So most teams skip it, and their best work ships to silence.

tday.com closes that gap. Connect your GitHub repo or point us at your site, and every release turns into a complete launch package: a demo video that shows how the feature works, a feature showcase built to sell it, and on-brand graphics for every placement, published to social automatically.

There are two ways in, and both produce both outputs. Connect your repo and tday spins up an isolated sandbox, captures the exact change in each pull request before it even merges, and posts the assets back to the PR to review or auto-publish. Or hand us a demo account set up exactly how you want to be marketed, pick the feature, and tday signs in, drives the real flow, and records it.

What makes it different is that everything is grounded in your real product and brand. tday already knows your colors, fonts, and voice, so output is on-brand every time, and you can tweak any line, scene, or image from the platform without re-recording the source. Ship a new version and the demo re-records itself: it captures a capability, not a one-off moment.

The creative we generate is already running at up to 8.3% CTR in early paid tests, several times the typical benchmark. Paid campaigns inside tday are next, and from there, marketing that scales at the speed you ship: hundreds of thousands of on-brand, hyper-targeted assets, generated and published automatically.

launches.title: Kuli: The AI coworker for marketing teams at Consumer Brands
launches.tagline: An AI agent that watches all videos on socials to help you plan and run campaigns faster.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Kuli is the AI coworker for influencer marketing teams at consumer brands. It watches every video, knows your brand, plans and runs your campaigns. 5 months in, the largest Fortune 100 entertainment brand now ships 3x more campaigns on Kuli.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0wdu4XS7BHk>

# **❌** The problem

Brand partnerships with creators are doubling in 2026. Teams are being asked to do more without additional headcount. More creators to find. More videos to watch. More emails and more reporting. Each of these steps is still manual.

A marketer's week looks like this :

* 8 hours scrolling TikTok to shortlist creators
* Wednesday morning catch-up on trends and competitor monitoring
* 100s of emails with creators
* Friday spent preparing the reporting of last campaign

That's one campaign. Most teams run several of them per month. They pay six figures a year for influencer tools that don't analyze video and leave teams to do the manual work themselves.

So they end up paying an agency to do the same manual work.

# ✅ What we built

**Kuli is the AI coworker for influencer marketing teams at consumer brands. It watches every video on socials, knows the brand, runs campaigns end to end.**

A marketer types :  “Find US microcreators (women, 30s) sharing parenthood struggles, with content around simplifying routines, aligned with an all-in-one skincare cream. Vet for brand fit, analyze past collab performance, and draft personalized outreach.”

While the marketer is in a meeting, Kuli is scrolling through millions of videos to surface the right creators. Reads every comment. Decodes the patterns behind top-performing content. Starts negotiating rates and pings the marketer when it needs input.

# 🧲 Early Traction

5 months in, and the largest Fortune 100 entertainment brand, the leading mobile gaming studio and some of the biggest cosmetics brands cut their agency fee and ship 3x more campaigns without adding headcount.

**Marketers orchestrate. Kuli operates.**

# 🧩 Team

Ten years ago we started building side hustles together. We then saw this problem from different angles :

**Michael Hodara** — built AI systems to run a $25M marketing budget at Aircall and Logitech based on voice and visual analysis. 

**Jonathan Hassan** — advised consumer brands at KPMG on billion-dollar deals. He saw them lose hundreds of millions because of the wrong creator choices.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100704&key=user_uploads/1865906/af16cbec-acb9-4ea5-a8cc-b8b2452b5e01)

# **📣 Our Ask**

If you **run social or influencer marketing at a brand**, we’re here to give you and your team your time back and help you outpace competition.

Book a demo on [kuli.one](http://kuli.one) or write to us on [founders@kuli.one](https://mailto:founders@kuli.one) if you want to see what the most effective consumer brands are already doing.

We’re also **hiring a growth genius**. Your unfair advantage: Kuli.\
You’ll see more content, spot patterns earlier, and move faster than anyone else. \
 Send us a video at [founders@kuli.one](https://mailto:founders@kuli.one).

name: CharacterQuilt
long_description:
CharacterQuilt builds computer use agents to deploy enterprise marketing campaigns. 

Marketers today don’t actually do much marketing at all.

Today, over 80% of time spent on launching a marketing campaign is actually ops work: tweaking automation flows in Pardot, configuring audiences in LinkedIn, or wiring HTML emails in Marketo. 

What’s crazy about enterprise marketing is companies pay agencies millions of dollars just to deploy campaigns in their systems — and they still have to wait weeks for each one.

CharacterQuilt is AI infrastructure for marketing teams: a brain that learns your brand, and agents that operate your existing tools. Marketing campaigns that used to take 3 agencies, 10 tools, and 6 weeks are now being built, designed, and deployed from CQ in an hour.

Customers submit a brief like they would send to a human teammate or marketing agency, and they get back fully designed and deployed campaigns.

Teams like 1upHealth, ABC Fitness, and Emplifi use us to:

1-) Build segments/audiences faster
2-) Create on-brand creative (AI is terrible at staying on-brand)
3-) Deploy campaigns automatically into HubSpot, WordPress, LinkedIn etc. 

We replicate your brand guidelines, deeply understand past campaigns, and work inside your systems.

If you run demand gen or lifecycle at a B2B/B2C company and want to ship campaigns faster, send us a brief and we’ll build it in 15 minutes.

launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Manicule owns docs and technical content for early-stage devtools across GEO, socials, and product videos. Twice as fast with AI and half the cost of hiring a DevRel, with solid results at Greptile, Skyvern, and Supermemory.

—

[**Manicule**](http://manicule.dev/) is a technical studio that owns your docs and developer-facing content end-to-end to help you grow. We write **for agents** and humans, ship in **<2 weeks**, and have delivered tangible results - **\~37%** less support tickets, millions of impressions on AI search & socials, and **$100K+** in enterprise deals closed across customers.

Customers include [**Greptile**](http://greptile.com/docs) (W24, $25M+ raised), [**Reducto**](http://docs.reducto.ai/) (W24, $100M+ raised), [**Supermemory**](http://supermemory.ai/docs), [Skyvern (S23),](http://skyvern.com/docs) Rootly, etc.

## **The Problem**

* Founders don’t have time to write docs, engineers hate doing it, and it ends up on the backlog forever.
* Nobody knows how to optimize their docs for agents
* AI tools like CC hallucinate code snippets and write empty content without nuance
* Docs sit unused as a growth channel, leaking signups to competitors with better content.

We solve that, and here’s proof.

We’ve engineered agent-optimized docs and benchmarked it on our clients’ docs. On average, agents perform **no errors** while using our approach vs **failing 25% of the time** with other frameworks.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101237&key=user_uploads/1069030/66c15ca0-661e-465a-9356-3af1492a195a)

## **Case Study: Supermemory**

Supermemory had two overlapping products and a lot of internal confusion about what each one was actually for. Customers couldn't figure it out either, and the docs were full of broken code snippets.

So, we:

* Got on calls with their CEO to lock down messaging and figure out the exact outcome each product was best for.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101237&key=user_uploads/1069030/19709c8a-0654-4eb0-988e-fcd387fe538a)

* Redesigned the information architecture from scratch. We mapped the journey from zero to "aha" and structured the docs like that.
* Wrote every page tied to a concrete developer outcome, with AI agents drafting from the OpenAPI spec and SDK definitions, then humans refining, testing every snippet, and cutting the fluff.

**Results:** 37% increase in answer success rate, multiple enterprise deals closed directly from docs, and viral reception on Twitter.

Here’s the Mintlify stats from **before** our engagement:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101237&key=user_uploads/1069030/3e448fc8-1672-4d58-bf45-44acd73b0d51)

And from after:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101237&key=user_uploads/1069030/37eaa68b-ab79-4c37-a41b-784a9fd3f115)

Besides the docs, we also created a lot of blog content, cookbooks, case studies, and videos for GEO, which have bought millions in impressions across AI search and socials.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101237&key=user_uploads/1069030/453c538a-5d5b-4b58-84a2-0c0112c364a2)

## **How we work**

You bring us in for a complete docs write-up that ships in **about 15 days** and **keep us on call 24/7** so your docs never fall behind. From there, we extend across your full developer growth surface like blogs, cookbooks, videos, social distribution, and GEO. All content written for both agents and humans.

## **Our asks**

* **If your docs need work, we'd love to talk.** You can book a call here: [**https://savvycal.com/manicule/intro**](https://savvycal.com/manicule/intro**)
* We’re working with a select few Seed+ companies first for blogs, videos, cookbooks, and overall developer marketing to deliver the best results. If you’d like to be one those, let’s chat: [**https://savvycal.com/manicule/intro**](https://savvycal.com/manicule/intro)

launches.title: TryNearby: Every local business needs to be discoverable. That $150B market is moving toward local creators.
launches.tagline: Word of mouth at scale for local restaurants
launches.body:
Hey everyone,

We're Yousef, Obaida, and Ahmad, the founders of **TryNearby**.

Yousef co-founded FaZe Clan and spent 15 years creating content for 10M+ followers alongside hundreds of other creators. Ahmad and Obaida co-founded one of the first social media clipping companies, building the infrastructure that tracked billions of views across thousands of videos for creator campaigns. We've watched creator content become the most powerful distribution channel on the internet, and we're bringing it to local businesses.

## **TL;DR**

84% of small businesses on TikTok say it helped grow their business. Almost every restaurant owner we meet knows that and has no idea how to act on it.

TryNearby handles it. Every month we send a new group of creators who live nearby to visit, film, and post a review, for a $399 subscription. All of it is handled by us and our AI agents.

Today, 120+ restaurants are subscribed and have had 2,500+ videos posted for them. We nearly doubled one restaurant's revenue in their first month, and owners tell us people walk in every day saying "we saw you on TikTok." Almost half our new restaurants now come from other owners referring us.

Our launch video: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lSG0v1MNwik>

## **The problem**

There are about 1 million restaurants and cafes in the US. Most of them are invisible in the places people actually decide where to eat.

The options an owner has today:

* Agencies cost thousands a month and often don’t drive real results
* Influencers work, but finding the right local ones, negotiating, and doing it again every month is a job by itself
* Creating their own content is a second full-time job they don't have time for, or a full-time hire they don't have the budget for

And here's the thing: _the algorithm doesn't reward a business talking about itself. It rewards people talking about the business._

So the thing that actually works — someone who lives nearby posting about your food — happens once or twice, or not at all.

And the platforms keep rewarding the ones who show up. TikTok's new Local Feed ranks by location and recency, so the restaurants getting fresh content every month reach their own neighborhood. The ones who don't, disappear.

## **The solution**

TryNearby is a subscription that puts local creators inside local restaurants every month, and their followers through the door.

$399/month. Every month we automatically schedule a new group of vetted creators who live nearby. They come in, film, edit, and post. The restaurant just serves the food.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=110956&key=user_uploads/3490413/7721f4f4-96e4-4a68-b860-841fee782765)

### **Part 1 — They sign up, creators start showing up**

The moment a restaurant joins, our matching agent finds the creators nearby who fit that spot and sends the invites. Sometimes a creator is scheduled to visit within five minutes of a restaurant signing up. Creators pick their own time from the restaurant's availability. The restaurant doesn't coordinate anything or answer a single message.

### **Part 2 — An AI agent runs every creator relationship**

Every creator on TryNearby is managed over iMessage by an agent we built. Onboarding, match invites, booking, reminders, reschedules, questions. It handles over 10,000 texts a month.

It also learns as it goes. Every conversation teaches it more about that creator: what they like to eat, where they'll actually drive, when they're free, what they turn down. That context feeds the matching, so the invites get better the longer someone is on the platform.

For creators, it's a personal assistant that helps them become better creators while bringing collaborations straight to their iMessage instead of them chasing restaurants.

### **Part 3 — Restaurant owners get their own AI agent to text**

Owners get an assistant in iMessage too. It watches every video, comment, and review, and tells them what's happening: who's visiting this week, how the last video performed, what people are saying. So when a dish sells out the week after a creator posted about it, the owner knows exactly why.

Our team sits behind both agents. Anything either one can't handle gets flagged to us in seconds.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=110956&key=user_uploads/3490413/5ff964f8-9013-42d7-9617-29d6ccb2164a)

## **Traction**

10 months in:

* 120+ paying restaurants across Southern California
* 37% month-over-month growth with over 90% monthly restaurant retention since November
* 2,500+ videos posted by local creators → \~35M views, almost entirely from people within a few miles

What that turned into for the restaurants:

* A restaurant in San Diego nearly doubled revenue in a single month
* Another had a whole new demographic of customers drive a 50% increase in sales
* Dishes featured in creator videos hit record sales the following week

Every single owner tells us the same thing: **people are walking in and saying they saw them on TikTok.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=110956&key=user_uploads/3490413/3301e743-2fef-43c4-9138-aaa5631d1eb8)

## **Team**

**Yousef** co-founded FaZe Clan after starting as a 14-year-old YouTuber in 2010. He spent 15 years in the creator economy, built an audience of 10M+ followers and over a billion views, and helped take FaZe public on the Nasdaq at a $1B valuation.

**Ahmad** co-founded one of the first social media clipping companies, where he built the first and largest infrastructure for short-form clipping, tracking 10B+ views across tens of thousands of videos for some of the biggest creators on the internet. UC Berkeley CS, previously a senior engineer at WeightWatchers.

**Obaida** co-founded the clipping company alongside Ahmad. He was an early employee at Replit, previously Goldman Sachs, and grew a consumer app from $360K to $2M ARR in 18 months. Master's in applied economics from Johns Hopkins.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=110956&key=user_uploads/3490413/031126b7-4cbd-49dc-989f-ef79381b8bd9)

If you own a restaurant, know an owner who wants more foot traffic, are a local creator, or are just interested in TryNearby, we'd love to talk → 📧 [hello@trynearby.com](https://mailto:hello@trynearby.com)
